nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Financial assistance programme supporting eligible patients with specified serious diseases and treatment expenses.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility is based on Kerala residency and current income/medical/category requirements prescribed for the programme.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karunya Benevolent Fund (KBF).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
